title: Beyond Boundary Noise: Aggregated Aleatoric Uncertainty Fails to Capture Presence Ambiguity in 3D Lung Nodule Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty estimation is critical for the safe clinical deployment of deep learning in medical image segmentation, with aleatoric uncertainty theoretically designed to capture irreducible data ambiguity. However, whether entropy-based measures reflect clinically meaningful ambiguity, i.e. case-level disagreement about whether a pathology is present at all, remains poorly understood. Contrary to most prior work, which focused on pixel-wise boundary disagreement, we systematically evaluate how well aleatoric uncertainty captures presence ambiguity. Our evaluation spans 3D lung nodule segmentation across four architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, on LIDC-IDRI and an external validation cohort (LNDb). We find that entropy-based uncertainty maps align with boundary noise and minor drawing variation but carry insufficient discriminative signal for presence ambiguity. translated_title: 超越边界噪声：聚合偶然不确定性未能捕捉三维肺结节分割中的存在模糊性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14766v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：不确定性估计对于深度学习在医学图像分割中的安全临床部署至关重要，其中偶然不确定性在理论上被设计用于捕捉不可约的数据模糊性。然而，基于熵的度量是否能反映临床上有意义的模糊性，即病例级别关于病理是否存在的分歧，仍知之甚少。与大多数先前关注像素级边界分歧的工作相反，我们系统性地评估了偶然不确定性在多大程度上捕捉存在模糊性。我们的评估涵盖了三维肺结节分割，涉及四种架构，使用蒙特卡洛丢弃和深度集成，基于LIDC-IDRI和一个外部验证队列（LNDb）。我们发现，基于熵的不确定性图与边界噪声和微小绘制差异对齐，但对于存在模糊性缺乏足够的判别信号。相比之下，一个轻量级的监督模糊性头（部分内容省略，原文可能后续有补充）
tldr: 本研究系统评估发现，基于熵的偶然不确定性在三维肺结节分割中主要反映边界噪声，无法有效捕捉临床关键的存在模糊性，而轻量级监督模糊性头提供了更好的判别信号。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates that entropy-based aleatoric uncertainty aligns with boundary noise but fails to capture clinically critical presence ambiguity in 3D lung nodule segmentation, while a lightweight supervised ambiguity head offers better discriminative signal.
